description: Project Defense and Behavioral Interview Scenarios, Rubrics, and Study Routing

official_interview_policy.disclaimer: Role-specific practice is not an official company interview unless supported by attributable current requirements with verified credentials.

project_templates.title: Event-Driven Distributed Pipeline
project_templates.tagline: High-throughput asynchronous ingestion stream with deduplication and idempotency.

core_decisions.choice: Redis sliding TTL window with SETNX idempotency keys
core_decisions.tradeoff: Low latency sub-millisecond lookups vs potential memory pressure if TTL is oversized

core_decisions.choice: Transactional Outbox table in PostgreSQL polled via Debezium CDC
core_decisions.tradeoff: Eliminates dual-write race conditions and partial commits at the expense of CDC connector complexity

known_constraints: Network partition between ingestion gateway and Kafka broker cluster
Poison-pill payloads causing repeated consumer worker crashes
Connection pool exhaustion on downstream PostgreSQL during burst traffic

project_templates.title: Adaptive Learning & Evaluation Platform
project_templates.tagline: Private adaptive interview tutor with deterministic planning and RLS isolation.

core_decisions.choice: Composite primary keys (owner_id, id) with Supabase Row-Level Security
core_decisions.tradeoff: Guaranteed multi-tenant isolation at the DB engine vs manual composite key propagation in queries

core_decisions.choice: Linear 80% capacity planning guard with priority revision queue
core_decisions.tradeoff: Prevents learner cognitive overload and churn vs slower sprint velocity

known_constraints: Zero leakage of private solutions and hidden test suites to candidate UI
Offline event synchronization during intermittent network connectivity

behavioral_scenarios.title: Major Production Incident & Critical Outage Triage
evaluation_criteria: Clear Situation: environment, blast radius, latency/error spike specifics
Actionable Task: candidate's specific ownership and role vs passive bystander
Systematic Action: telemetry analysis, mitigation before deep diagnosis, rollback decision
Quantified Result: MTTR, customer impact prevention, permanent blameless postmortem fixes

behavioral_scenarios.title: Architectural Disagreement & Cross-Functional Alignment
evaluation_criteria: Situation: conflicting architectural proposals between engineers or teams
Task: candidate's responsibility in driving consensus and unblocking the roadmap
Action: objective benchmarking, prototype spikes, collaborative RFC review without dogmatism
Result: agreed architectural direction, delivered milestone, team relationship preservation

gap_to_study_routing.rationale: Learner lacked deployment metrics or could not quantify production scale vs local testing.
Learner could not explain database or cache locking semantics under concurrent write bursts.
Learner asserted high throughput without bottleneck identification or memory/network sizing.
Learner provided vague behavioral results without measurable outcomes or blameless postmortem follow-up.
